questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

His father said to him, "I cannot allow you to waste my hard-earned money.'

options.text: His father told him that he could not allow him to waste his hard-earned money.
His father told him that he cannot allow you to waste his hard-earned money.
His father told him that I cannot allow you to waste my hard-earned money
His father told him that he could not allow you to waste his hard-earned money.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'His father told him that he could not allow him to waste his hard-earned money.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• Here, in the given question 'said to' will be changed into 'told' because the reporting speech has an object. 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• The pronoun 'I' will be changed into 'he' and** ****'My'** will be changed into **'his' **because the first person pronouns are changed according to the subject of the reporting verb. 
 
• 'cannot allow' will be changed into 'could not allow'. 
 
• The **pronoun** '**you**' will be changed according to the **object** of the **reporting** **verb** that is '**him**'. 
 
 

 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1. **
 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *His father told him that he could not allow him to waste his hard-earned money.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Direct Speech में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Indirect Speech में बदलना है।
 
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
• यहां, दिए गए प्रश्न में **'said to'** को '**told**' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि **reporting** **speech** में एक **object** है।
 
• संयोजन '**that**' जोड़ा जाएगा और अल्पविराम और उल्टे अल्पविराम हटा दिए जाएंगे।
 
• सर्वनाम '**I**' को 'he' में बदल दिया जाएगा और '**my**' को '**his**' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि **reporting** **verb** के **subject** के अनुसार **first person pronouns** बदल दिए जाते हैं।
 
• '**cannot allow**' को '**could not allow**' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• सर्वनाम '**you**' को **reporting verb** की **object** के अनुसार बदल दिया जाएगा जो कि '**him**' है।
 
 
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Direct Speech

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Mawsmai Cave is one of the most alluring tourist destinations near Cherrapunji in the northeast Indian state of Meghalaya.

B. Other sections of the cave are off the limits for tourists.

C. The cave is quite big. However, the tourists can visit it up to a distance of 150 metres only.

D. The limestone cave has spellbinding beauty and is the only cave which is naturally illuminated to let the tourists cherish natural formations
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'ADCB'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Sentence Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of a story, starting of an incident or an event, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Sentence A in the given question is the starting of a story. The author is talking about a tourist site named 'Mwasmai Cave' which is located in 'Meghalaya'.
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because Mawsami Cave is one of the most alluring tourist destinations. It is a limestone cave and it is naturally formed.
 
• Sentence C will be the next sentence because it further explains the cave. And how far the tourists visit the cave.
 
• Lastly, Sentence B will be used.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• **A**: Mawsmai Cave is one of the most alluring tourist destinations near Cherrapunji in the northeast Indian state of Meghalaya.
 
• D: The limestone cave has spellbinding beauty and is the only cave which is naturally illuminated to let the tourists cherish natural formations
 
• C: The cave is quite big. However, the tourists can visit it up to a distance of 150 metres only.
 
• B: Other sections of the cave are off the limits for tourists.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.

**Correct Sequence:__** *Mawsmai Cave is one of the most alluring tourist destinations near Cherrapunji in the northeast Indian state of Meghalaya. The limestone cave has spellbinding beauty and is the only cave which is naturally illuminated to let the tourists cherish natural formations. The cave is quite big. However, the tourists can visit it up to a distance of 150 metres only. Other sections of the cave are off the limits for tourists.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The maid was dusting the hall when the door-bell rang.

options.text: The door-bell rang when the maid is dusting the hall.
The door-bell rang by the maid when the hall was dusted.
The door-bell rang when the hall was being dusted by the maid.
The door-bell rang when the maid was dusting the hall.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The door-bell rang when the hall was being dusted by the maid'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Passive Form. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence as follows:
 
 
• Subject + was/were + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case)+ was/were + being + V3+ by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He was riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike was being ridden by him.*
 
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'past continuous'. 
 
• The given sentence has **two clauses.**
 
• We have to change the **voice** of part one that is *'The maid was dusting the hall...'*
 
• **'was dusting'** will be changed into **'was being dusted'.**
 
• The **subject** will be put in place of the **object** and the **object** will be put in place of the **subject**.
 
• The preposition 'by' will be added.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 ​

**Correct Sentence__**: *The door-bell rang when the hall was being dusted by the maid.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **Active Voice** में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें वाक्य को **Passive Voice** में बदलना है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• Subject + was/were + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case)+ was/were + being + V3+ by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He was riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike was being ridden by him.*
 
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **'past continuous'** का उदाहरण है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में **'two clauses'** हैं।
 
• हमें पहले भाग की **voice** को बदलना होगा i.e. *'The maid was dusting the hall...'*
 
• **'was dusting'** को** 'was being dusted' **में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• **Object** के स्थान पर **Subject** रखा जाएगा और **Subject** के स्थान पर **Object** रखी जाएगी।
 
• The preposition '**by**' जोड़ा जाएगा।
 
 
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3** है।

__
 
• Transformation of **Infinitives**:
 
• Structure of it is as follows
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are/was/were/has/have/had + to+ V1+ Object. 
 
• Subject(Objective case) + is/am/are/was/were/has/have/had+to+be+ V3 + by+ object(subjective case). 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Your child is to learn chess. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Chess is to be learnt by your child. (Passive Voice)*

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. When John was five years old, a circus came to the village.

B. John saw the circus people and slipped out of the house.

C. After a long search, his father found him among the trained goats and dogs.

D. It put up its tents in front of the Town Hall.
questions.solution:

• Sentence A in the given question is the starting of a story. It is talking about a circus held in John's village when he was five years old.
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because it tells about the place where the circus was held.
 
• Sentence B will be the next sentence because it further explains what John saw in the circus.
 
• Lastly, Sentence C will be used.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• A: When John was five years old, a circus came to the village.
 
• D: It put up its tents in front of the Town Hall.
 
• B: John saw the circus people and slipped out of the house.
 
• C: After a long search, his father found him among the trained goats and dogs.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.
